title: 预约与服务咨询对话
goal: 按预约结构定位信息，并核对订金、取消及附加服务的适用条件。

points.label: 按预约对话的结构寻找信息
识别服务条款的适用条件

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 听力课的内容、知识点与教学规格

cards.title: 结构
rows: 需求说明
I'd like a cabin for two nights.
We need a court for an hour.
先听要订什么、订多久。这时还不知道有没有空位。
可用时段
The cabin is free from Friday.
The court is available after six.
这里的 free 是有空，不是免费。
限制条件
A deposit is required to secure it.
Only members can book the evening slot.
条件决定方案能不能用，only 要听清。
确认句
The cabin is reserved for both nights.
The court is booked from six to seven.
确认句给出最后订下的对象和时段。前面提到的其他选择不算。
cards.note: 两类对话都按需求、可用时段、条件、确认的顺序推进。条款以本段录音为准，不套用其他服务的规则。

cards.title: 常用表达：订金
rows: pay a deposit
先付一部分钱，余款以后付。
A £25 deposit is payable when booking.
secure the booking
付了订金，预约就保留下来。
The deposit secures the booking.
deducted from the total
已付的订金从总价中扣除。
The deposit will be deducted from the total, leaving the balance due on arrival.
refundable provided that
满足后面的条件才能退。
The deposit is refundable provided that cancellation reaches us before Monday.

cards.title: 常用表达：取消
rows: give notice
提前通知，要听清提前多久。
Please give at least two days' notice of cancellation.
no later than
最晚到这个时点，包括这个时点。
Cancellations must reach us no later than noon on Tuesday.
a cancellation fee applies
在所说的情况下收取消费。
A cancellation fee applies after that deadline.
non-refundable
这笔钱不退，要听清指的是哪一笔。
For cancellations on the day, the deposit is non-refundable.

cards.title: 常用表达：附加服务
rows: included in the price
该项目已含在报价内，不再单独收费。
Bed linen is included in the price.
at an additional charge
可以用，但要另付钱。
Towels are available at an additional charge.
on request
要提出才提供，可能另收费。
A cot is available on request for £8.
subject to availability
有余量才提供。
Late checkout is subject to availability.

body.box:
A: I'd like a cabin from Friday to Sunday.
B: That period is available. A £30 deposit secures the booking, with the balance due on arrival. Linen is included; towels cost £4.
A: What happens if I cancel?
B: The deposit is refundable if notice reaches us by noon on Wednesday. After that, it isn't refundable.
A: Those terms are suitable. Please reserve the cabin.
B: The cabin is reserved for those nights.

body.p: 需求是周五至周日，回复说这段时间有空房。订金只是保留预订，余款到达时付。床单包含在内，毛巾另收 £4，这是两项条款。

body.box:
A: Could I hire the practice room after six?
B: It's available, but evening bookings are for members only.
A: I'm a member. Please book seven to eight.
B: Seven to eight is confirmed. Music stands are included. A keyboard is available on request for £5.

body.p: 住宿按入住的几晚定位，设施按使用的时段定位。members only 规定只有会员能订。on request for £5 有两层意思：要提出申请，还要另付 £5。

body.box:
Under the cabin terms, which cancellation qualifies for a deposit refund?
1. Notice received on Thursday morning
2. Notice received on Wednesday evening
3. Notice received on Wednesday at 11 a.m.
4. Notice received on Friday before arrival

body.p: 第三项在周三中午之前，符合退款条件。第四项虽然在入住前，但已过了周三中午的期限。

cards.title: 常见错误
rows: 可用与免费混同
The room is free on Friday. → 无房费
这里说的是有空房。价格要另找报价的话轮。
先付与全额混同
deposit → 已付清全部费用
balance due on arrival 说明余款到达时付。
截止时点遗漏
before arrival → 必定退订金
看退款的截止时点，入住前不一定能退。
附加服务范围扩大
linen included → towels included
逐项看哪些包含、哪些另付。
申请等于承诺
on request → 无须确认即可提供
听清是否另收费，是否 subject to availability。

lines.text: I'd like to hire a projector for Saturday.
There's one available then. Friday's unit is already booked.

items.stem: Which part of the enquiry does the reply resolve?
options: Whether a projector is free on Saturday
Whether the Saturday booking is confirmed
Whether the Saturday hire has been paid
Whether both days have been confirmed
items.why: There's one available then 回答了周六有没有设备，即第一项。回复没有说已经确认预订。

lines.text: The rehearsal room costs twenty pounds. A five-pound deposit secures it.
So fifteen pounds remains to be paid?
That's right.

items.stem: What does payment of the deposit achieve?
options: It settles the full twenty-pound charge.
It reserves the room with a balance remaining.
It covers fifteen pounds of the charge.
It replaces the remaining fifteen-pound payment.
items.why: deposit secures it 与 fifteen pounds remains to be paid 共同说明保留预约但尚未付清。

lines.text: What's the cancellation deadline for the picnic shelter?
A refund is available if notice arrives before six on Thursday. After six, the fee is retained.

items.stem: Which cancellation meets the refund condition?
options: Thursday at seven in the evening
Friday at five in the afternoon
Thursday at five in the afternoon
Friday at seven in the evening
items.why: before six on Thursday 包含周四下午五点，其他时点均更晚。

lines.text: The laptop is booked for the afternoon. A charger is included, and a carrying case costs three pounds.
Please add the case as well.

items.stem: Which statement describes the accepted extra?
options: A free case replaces the included charger.
The charger costs three pounds with the case.
Both accessories are already included free.
The case adds a charge to the laptop booking.
items.why: a carrying case costs three pounds 后接 Please add the case，说明接受另付费用的附加项目。

lines.text: I'm enquiring about hiring the village meeting room for a sewing circle. We need a quiet room on Monday evening, with enough tables for eight people.
The small meeting room is free from seven until nine. The larger hall has a dance class, so it wouldn't be quiet. The small room has tables and chairs included in the hire price.
That sounds suitable. Would we be able to use an iron?
An iron is available on request, but there's a separate two-pound charge. Please ask for it when confirming the booking so it can be placed in the room.
Please include the iron and book the small room from seven to nine.
That's confirmed. If the session is cancelled, let the office know before noon on Friday for a refund. Later cancellation means the hire fee is retained.

items.stem: Which room and period have been confirmed?
options: The large hall from seven to nine
The small room from seven to nine
The small room before seven
The large hall before the dance class
items.why: book the small room from seven to nine 后得到 That's confirmed，排除较吵的大厅。

items.stem: What is required to obtain the iron?
options: A request on arrival, with no extra charge
The room fee alone, without a request
A request when booking and a separate charge
Booking the small room before Friday noon
items.why: 依据是 ask for it when confirming 和 separate two-pound charge。要在确认预订时提出，还要另付 2 镑，即第三项。

items.stem: Which cancellation qualifies for a refund?
options: Friday morning before noon
Friday afternoon after noon
Monday before seven
Monday after the session
items.why: before noon on Friday 是退款的截止时点，即第一项。周一活动开始前已超过期限。

lines.text: Hello, I'm looking for a lakeside cabin for a family visit. We need somewhere from Saturday until Monday, and I'd prefer one with a small kitchen because we'll prepare our own meals.
The kitchen cabins are available for those nights. The simpler sleeping cabins are also free, but they don't have cooking facilities. A kitchen cabin costs ninety pounds per night.
I'll choose a kitchen cabin. Is the whole amount due when booking, or is there a deposit?

A forty-pound deposit secures the reservation. It's deducted from the total, and the balance is due on arrival. Cancellation before noon on Thursday qualifies for a full deposit refund. After that deadline, the deposit is retained.
Understood. Are bed linen and towels both included?
Linen is included. Towels cost five pounds per set and must be requested in advance.
We'll bring our own towels. Please reserve the kitchen cabin for both nights.
That's confirmed. The arrival details will be sent with the booking confirmation, and the kitchen equipment will be listed there as well.

items.stem: What requirement explains the choice of cabin?
options: The family needs towels supplied.
The family wants a single night.
The family plans to cook meals.
The family wants no arrival payment.
items.why: because we'll prepare our own meals 说明需求，kitchen cabin 满足自行做饭的条件。

items.stem: What is confirmed at the end of the conversation?
options: A sleeping cabin with hired towels
A kitchen cabin for one night
A sleeping cabin for both nights
A kitchen cabin without hired towels
items.why: reserve the kitchen cabin for both nights 且 We'll bring our own towels，对应不租毛巾的厨房小屋。

items.stem: Which cancellation qualifies for the stated deposit refund?
options: Notice received on Thursday before noon
Notice received on Thursday after noon
Notice received on Saturday before arrival
Notice received on Monday before departure
items.why: before noon on Thursday 是退款条件，即第一项。周六到达前已超过期限。

lines.text: Good evening. I'm enquiring about hiring a badminton court for a workplace group. We can only meet after six, and we'd like to play for an hour. None of us has used this centre before.
The evening courts are for members, although one member can make a booking for a group. There are vacancies at six and at seven. Is anyone in the group a member?
One colleague is. I'll ask her to make the booking. We prefer seven. Are rackets part of the court price?
Rackets can be hired for two pounds each. Shuttlecocks are included in the court fee. Cancellation at least twenty-four hours before the start receives a refund; later cancellation doesn't.
That's clear. My colleague will book the seven o'clock court, but please don't treat this enquiry as a reservation. I still need to check whether everyone has a racket.
Certainly. Nothing is reserved yet. The membership number will be required when the booking is made, and racket hire can be added then.
I'll pass those details to my colleague.

items.stem: What stage has this conversation reached?
options: A reservation paid for by the whole group
An enquiry awaiting a member's booking
A confirmed booking with racket hire
A cancellation awaiting repayment
items.why: please don't treat this enquiry as a reservation 与 Nothing is reserved yet 一致，仍待会员正式预订。

items.stem: Which arrangement meets the evening-booking condition?
options: A member books on behalf of the group.
Every player hires a racket before booking.
The whole group pays the shuttlecock charge.
A non-member reserves before checking membership.
items.why: one member can make a booking for a group 说明一名会员可以替全组预订，即第一项。

items.stem: Which statement preserves the equipment terms?
options: Rackets are included, but shuttlecocks cost extra.
Rackets cost extra, while shuttlecocks are included.
Both rackets and shuttlecocks are included.
Both rackets and shuttlecocks cost extra.
items.why: Rackets can be hired for two pounds each 与 Shuttlecocks are included 区分另付和包含。
